included: train1/train2 per-file and pooled profiling statistics
excluded: train3 confirmation arithmetic beyond the frozen interface
scientific interpretation beyond the frozen claim boundary

source_parameter_derivation.input: each frozen source column from normal hai-train1.csv and hai-train2.csv
source_parameter_derivation.finite_input_contract: the authorized loader parses only the frozen 24 P1 source/target columns and rejects malformed, nonnumeric, or nonfinite cells; no imputation occurs
source_parameter_derivation.file_boundary: first differences and five-sample windows are computed within each file only; no cross-file difference or window exists
source_parameter_derivation.noise_scale: max(1.4826 * MAD(all within-file one-step differences pooled after file-local differencing), 1e-12)
source_parameter_derivation.split_influence: train1/train2 only; train3 does not influence these parameters

source_event_extraction.signal_handling: all 12 frozen sources are treated as finite numeric continuous-step signals under one common detector; there is no separate discrete-source branch
source_event_extraction.event_index_semantics: t is the boundary between the five preceding samples x[t-5:t] and the five following samples x[t:t+5]
source_event_extraction.direction_rule: step_up when signed_amplitude > 0, otherwise step_down after zero and below-threshold amplitudes have already been rejected
source_event_extraction.stability_rule: at least 4 of 5 samples in each pre and post window must be within source_stability_tolerance of its median; equality to tolerance passes
source_event_extraction.missing_nonfinite_handling: the loader and sequence normalization fail closed; no missing-value imputation, clipping, or event repair
source_event_extraction.boundary_handling: events without complete five-sample pre and post source windows are not candidates
source_event_extraction.file_boundary_handling: train1 and train2 are scanned independently
source_event_extraction.continuous_discrete_handling: one sustained-continuous-step implementation is used for control_command, actuator_feedback, and actuator_state roles; no role-specific event formula is present
source_event_extraction.semantic_parity: passed in the frozen complexity-recovery receipt and independently reproduced in the D1 final audit

refractory_clustering.scope: same source and file local, across both step directions before later direction filtering
refractory_clustering.linkage: single-link: the next event joins the current cluster when its index is at most 10 samples after the immediately preceding event in that cluster
refractory_clustering.retention: one event per cluster: largest absolute step amplitude, with earliest event index as the exact tie-break
refractory_clustering.duplicate_prevention: overlapping/nearby detections collapse to one retained event; single-link chains can span more than 10 seconds end-to-end

cross_source_isolation.source_context: all 12 frozen source streams in the same file
cross_source_isolation.rule: a retained event is isolated only when no retained event from any other source has an index within [t-2, t+2]
cross_source_isolation.same_source_events: do not disqualify isolation; same-source proximity was already handled by refractory clustering
cross_source_isolation.semantic_parity: passed; inclusive boundaries at -2 and +2 were explicitly covered by synthetic parity fixtures

event_pipeline_pseudocode: validate every source value as finite
derive one normal-only source noise scale, step threshold, and stability tolerance from train1/train2
for each fit file independently and each complete five-before/five-after index t
compute pre and post medians and signed amplitude
retain only threshold-passing candidates with at least 0.80 stable fractions on both sides
label retained candidate step_up or step_down from amplitude sign
single-link cluster each source/file event stream with successive gaps <= 10
retain largest absolute amplitude per cluster, earliest t on an exact tie
classify each retained event against all other frozen sources using inclusive +/-2 isolation
later, for each source direction, use only retained isolated events with that direction

target_parameter_derivation.input: each frozen target column from normal train1 and train2
target_parameter_derivation.noise_scale: max(1.4826 * MAD(all within-file one-step target differences pooled after file-local differencing), 1e-12)
target_parameter_derivation.scope: computed once per target and reused across every candidate pair and arm involving that target

target_response_measurement.source_event_filter: retained isolated event whose source direction equals the directional opportunity under evaluation
target_response_measurement.unit: same physical unit as the target signal
target_response_measurement.normalization: no response normalization; target_noise_scale is used only for direction classification and the robust-effect ratio
target_response_measurement.neutral: response in the closed interval [-target_noise_scale, +target_noise_scale] matches neither direction
target_response_measurement.right_censor_rule: when t < 5 or t+h+3 exceeds the file length, mark right-censored and do not impute or include that response
target_response_measurement.file_boundary: target windows never cross train files

per_file_and_pooled_statistics.evaluated_grid_per_source_direction: 2 target-response directions x 5 frozen horizons = 10 records

per_file.usable_response_count: number of non-right-censored responses from retained isolated source events of the chosen source direction
per_file.right_censored_count: chosen-direction isolated source events lacking a complete target response window
per_file.directional_match_count: usable responses strictly beyond target_noise_scale in the evaluated target direction
per_file.opposite_direction_match_count: usable responses strictly beyond target_noise_scale in the opposite direction
per_file.selected_directional_consistency: directional_match_count / usable_response_count, or 0 when no usable response
per_file.opposite_directional_consistency: opposite_direction_match_count / usable_response_count, or 0 when no usable response

pooled.pooling: concatenate usable train1 and train2 responses after computing file-local windows
pooled.total_usable_responses: sum of train1 and train2 usable responses
pooled.pooled_directional_consistency: sum of selected-direction match counts / total usable responses, or 0 when empty
pooled.pooled_median_response: median of all usable train1/train2 responses
pooled.pooled_robust_effect_ratio: abs(pooled_median_response) / target_noise_scale, or 0 when no usable response

per_file_and_pooled_statistics.important_non_equivalence: file identities are preserved for support and direction-consistency gates; pooled evidence does not replace the per-file requirements

direction_horizon_selection_and_fit_gate.eligibility_before_ranking: the selected target direction must have strictly greater consistency than its opposite direction in both train1 and train2; equality fails
direction_horizon_selection_and_fit_gate.selection_order: choose one target-direction/horizon record first for each source direction, then apply the fit gate only to that record
direction_horizon_selection_and_fit_gate.pair_semantics: step_up and step_down are evaluated independently, so a source-target candidate pair can yield zero, one, or two fit-supported directional opportunities

frozen_execution_evidence.independent_replay: passed with event clustering, all-source isolation, support, step directions, source/target parameters, and normalized directional records reproduced

stat_discovery_separation.shared_inputs: both stages use normal train1/train2 and the same five horizon labels
stat_discovery_separation.shared_candidate_identity: relation profiling consumes the frozen candidate union identities, which may include STAT provenance only after outcomes freeze
stat_discovery_separation.stat_method: first-difference lagged Pearson association used to rank candidate pairs
stat_discovery_separation.profiling_method: event-anchored median-step and delayed-target-response statistics used to select direction/horizon and gate relation support
stat_discovery_separation.import_boundary: task039d1_fit_v1 and relation_profiling_protocol_v1 do not import statistical_candidate_discovery_v1 or reuse its correlations
stat_discovery_separation.arm_blindness: candidate-arm evidence is hidden during the common 47-pair profiling execution and joined only after outcomes freeze

important_semantic_boundaries: A candidate pair is not a profiled or confirmed relation.
Fit-supported output is a normal delayed-response relation candidate, not causal or physical truth.
The selected horizon is the highest-ranked member of a preregistered finite grid under this metric, not a demonstrated optimal physical lag.
Response direction is thresholded relative to a normal target noise scale; neutral responses match neither direction.
Refractory clustering is applied before source-direction filtering, so nearby step_up and step_down detections can compete within one same-source cluster.

unknowns_and_audit_notes.finding: The D1 loader requires a timestamp column but does not parse or independently verify timestamp continuity; horizon and refractory values named in seconds are implemented as row-index offsets.
unknowns_and_audit_notes.impact: The one-second interpretation depends on the frozen HAI manifest/sampling authority rather than a timestamp-continuity check inside the profiler.

unknowns_and_audit_notes.finding: The same event formula is applied to every approved source role, including actuator_state; there is no role-specific discrete-state detector.
unknowns_and_audit_notes.impact: Descriptions should call this the frozen continuous-step protocol and should not imply separate discrete handling.

unknowns_and_audit_notes.finding: Single-link refractory clustering can join a chain whose first and last candidate detections are more than 10 seconds apart.
unknowns_and_audit_notes.impact: Documentation should say single-link clustering, not a fixed non-overlapping 10-second suppression window.
